title: Replicating MALT Sandbagging Detection on Models Fine-Tuned to Sandbag

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Excellent chain: directly tests adversarial robustness of published monitoring results. If monitors fail against fine-tuned sandbagging, current monitoring provides false assurance. This is a high-impact finding either way.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Fine-tuning a model to sandbag requires creating a fine-tuning dataset of subtle underperformance, running fine-tuning on Gemma-2-2B, then evaluating with MALT monitors. Fine-tuning and dataset creation are challenging for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three phases: (1) create sandbagging fine-tuning data, (2) fine-tune model, (3) evaluate with monitors. Each phase is a project component. The dataset design for subtle sandbagging requires sophistication. Challenging to complete in 30 hours.
